label: About
title: About Green Rupture Section
short_blurb: A daily generated front page where the image is the interface.
body: Daily Frontpage is a daily generated interactive front page. Each edition starts from recent saved signals and source research, becomes a new image-led scene, and stays explorable in the archive. The image is the interface: visible marks, objects, and surfaces in the scene open the real sources that shaped the day.

This iteration began with 77 recent saved-signal files and 71 captured links, then narrowed the page to 9 source windows around Anchor image material 7 and @MTSlive: NYU Prof. Ruby Thelot on why everyone suddenly cares about taste: "I wrote a book..., plus 7 more. A source image from pbs.twimg.com helped set the palette, contrast, edge behavior, and gesture. The scene became Green Rupture Section: Abstract architectural section, landscape camera plate grammar: a long saturated green rupture rail spans the upper-middle nearly edge to edge, breaking pale archive-plaster space cut by diagonal seams. After the image was made, a plate-reading pass mapped 9 visible regions and the mask audit tightened them against dominant smeared green horizontal rail, lower turquoise felt table plane, and right-margin dark standing figure cluster.

typography.rationale: Bricolage Grotesque and Space Grotesk fit record, arcade, and listening-room editions while Fraunces keeps source captions tactile.
